headline: Marvell to buy Lumentum in all-stock deal, a massive bet on AI connectivity
detail: This all-stock deal for AI connectivity is raising "dot-com bubble" flashbacks. This creates negative sentiment for the chip sector, where you are heavily concentrated.
rec: Given the negative sentiment and your heavy chip exposure, consider trimming positions like SMH or SOXL to reduce risk.

headline: Anthropic reports $17 billion in Q3 revenue, purchase commitments of $895.4 billion in revised S-1
detail: Strong revenue and commitments from a major AI player indicate continued growth in the AI sector. This is a positive signal for your AI-related tech holdings.
rec: This headline is positive for the broader AI theme in your portfolio, but doesn't warrant an immediate trade on a specific holding or new buy today.
